name: Resistance Ring
short_description: Enables Covert Actions with resistance factions; unlocks Resistance Orders. War of the Chosen only.

attributes.staffing_slots: 1-2 Engineers -- each reduces Covert Action completion time by 33%.
attributes.ruleset_note: War of the Chosen only; no vanilla XCOM 2 equivalent.

name: Infirmary
short_description: Heals injured soldiers and removes negative traits. War of the Chosen only -- replaces part of the vanilla Advanced Warfare Center's function.

attributes.staffing_slots: 1 Scientist -- increases wound recovery speed by 50%.
attributes.ruleset_note: War of the Chosen only; together with the Training Center, replaces the vanilla-only Advanced Warfare Center.

name: Training Center
short_description: Allows soldiers to purchase abilities with Ability Points (including cross-class options) and retrain abilities. War of the Chosen only -- replaces part of the vanilla Advanced Warfare Center's function.

attributes.ruleset_note: War of the Chosen only; together with the Infirmary, replaces the vanilla-only Advanced Warfare Center.

name: Reaper
short_description: Reapers resistance-faction hero class; stealth and long-range specialist.

name: Skirmisher
short_description: Skirmishers resistance-faction hero class; mobile assault specialist.

name: Templar
short_description: Templars resistance-faction hero class; melee/psionic hybrid specialist.
